verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly claim Claude Code 'maps and explains entire codebases in a few seconds' using agentic search to understand project structure and dependencies without manual context selection, and separately states it 'understands your entire codebase' across files; CLAUDE.md further lets teams encode architecture decisions for onboarding. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration specifically validating codebase-mapping accuracy, and no benchmark or case study showing it correctly locates the right starting point in a large real-world repo.
